EXHIBIT A
PLAINTIFF’S FOUR PROPOSED INTERROGATORIES TO META PLATFORMS,
INC.

Pursuant to the accompanying Motion under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 26(d)(1),
Plaintiff Marvelle J. Ballentine propounds the following four interrogatories to Defendant Meta
Platforms, Inc. (“Meta”), to be answered under oath pursuant to Federal Rule of Civil Procedure
33. Meta shall answer each interrogatory only: “Yes,” “No,” or “Unable to determine after
reasonable inquiry.” The interrogatories seek no explanation and no report content.

INTERROGATORY NO. 1: Between July 1, 2022 and April 22, 2026, did Meta

submit to NCMEC a CyberTipline report in connection with the Facebook account
associated with Plaintiff and terminated on or about July 4, 2022?

INTERROGATORY NO. 2: Did any such report, as submitted by Meta, contain or
otherwise identify “Marvelle J. Ballentine”?
